clock: record time = narration time of the accepted cut (11110 frames at 24 fps); record frame = segment rec_in_f + (take source frame - src_in_f) from docs/EP05_TIMELINE.json; timecode HH:MM:SS:FF

method.onset: 10 ms RMS envelope (mono) of the take's embedded audio versus its local median (+/-0.6 s). Verdict at each contact frame uses the strongest rise within +/-max(8, tolerance) frames: PRESENT = rise >= 8 dB and offset within tolerance (at least 3 f); PRESENT, OFFSET = rise >= 8 dB but outside tolerance; WEAK = 5-8 dB; NOT FOUND = under 5 dB. Sustained spans: ACTIVE = at least 2 onsets >= 8 dB or median >= 10 dB above the take floor, else QUIET.
method.character: Per onset: spectral flatness 200-8000 Hz, spectral centroid, and the peak normalised autocorrelation at 80-600 Hz ('voicing'). voicing >= 0.6 = pitched or voiced (flagged PITCHED); flatness >= 0.1 = broadband click or rustle; otherwise low thud.
method.tonal_scan: STFT 85 ms, narrow-line prominence versus +/-150 Hz neighbours; spans with >= 25 dB prominence for >= 0.5 s at >= -75 dBFS. The scan reproduces all four existing tonal mutes (V20, V26, V28, V29), which validates it.
method.room_tone: Per take, over the picture actually used and outside policy mutes: noise floor = 10th percentile of the 10 ms RMS; build_fx gain re-computed exactly as ulac/edit.py build_fx (per-clip -24 dBFS RMS target, peak cap -4 dBFS, +18 dB max, stereo, mutes applied); floor after gain = floor + gain.
method.limits: Nothing was auditioned. A PRESENT verdict means an unvoiced onset exists at that frame, not that the sound is the expected one.
